page.layout: Two blocks on one printed page: the running text in one column with a heading block at its top, and marginal references in the left margin. Page number 520 at the upper left, running title at the top centre. No text below the main column.

main_text.head: CAP. II. De conditione hominis lapsi.
CAP. III. De redemptione per Christum Dominum nostrum.

page.notes: The scan is badly faded and blotched, so almost all of the Latin running text cannot be read with confidence and is marked illegible in lines of approximate length. The headings CAP. II, CAP. III and CAP. IV and their titles are readable only in part; the title of CAP. II and the exact words of the headings are doubtful. Marginal references, left margin, as far as legible: Rom. 3; Eph. 2; Job. 25; 1 Cor. 2; Rom. 8; Rom. 5; Eph. 2; Esa. 66; Joan. 3; Rom. 5; Eph. 1; Esa. 53; 1 Pet. 2; 2 Cor. 5; Rom. 3; Joan. 3; 1 Cor. 1; Psal. 3; 1 Cor. 5; Tit. 3. Several of these are doubtful and are not transcribed as notes because they are not legible enough to place exactly beside their lines.
